name: Dumaguete
summary: First-party English and Filipino-language discovery evidenced Dumaguete City's CPDO as a local cadastral-map custodian/procedure. The national Geoportal LMB parcel layer was inspected through its public viewer endpoints, but its metadata limits the dataset to selected Metro Manila areas. Direct GeoServer WFS/WMS routes timed out; no parcel geometry or native identity was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcome: All executed discovery queries and direct viewer/service requests are recorded in city-4996-dumaguete.json. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe owner/title/address fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS verification disablement was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if exposed
full parcel polygon geometry if obtained
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
Timeouts and the Metro Manila metadata scope are not evidence of citywide Dumaguete absence.
The city CPDO page evidences an on-request map procedure, not an open parcel API.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; runtime readiness remains held pending serial review.

qualification.reason: No bounded anonymous Dumaguete parcel response with a safe native identity and polygon was obtained.

uncertainty: Citywide parcel coverage, API availability, native identity schema, geometry completeness and update cadence remain unresolved.
